assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness, raising concern for paroxysmal atrial fibrillation in the context of a personal history of transient ischemic attacks and cerebral infarction.
Mobile cardiac telemetry (CPT 93229) was ordered to capture intermittent arrhythmic events and correlate them with symptoms to guide appropriate anticoagulation and rate control management.
The service is directly supported by the clinical indication note, which documents the arrhythmic concern and the diagnostic purpose of the monitoring.
The payer denied the claim with Reason Code CO-197, indicating that the required precertification or prior authorization was not obtained before services were rendered.
The medical necessity documented in the clinical indication note substantiates the need for advance approval of this diagnostic procedure mandated by plan guidelines.
